title: Cohomology commutes with filtered colimits on quasi-compact spaces
statement: Let X be a topological space such that the quasi-compact open subsets form a basis and the intersection of two quasi-compact opens is quasi-compact. For every filtered system (F_i) of sheaves of abelian groups on X and every quasi-compact open U of X, the canonical map colim_i H^q(U,F_i) \to H^q(U,colim_i F_i) is an isomorphism for every q>=0, where H^q is sheaf cohomology as in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].
